## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness); positive sectors are Energy and Utilities. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy in Top 5); confirmed by low breadth and concentrated Energy/Materials outperformance — Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing pockets of strength: DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials weak: GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary also lagging: TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +6.08%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND; APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY; DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PSA (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND; GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; EMR (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -5.78% | 1M: +11.22%) CORRECTION; NEM (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND; Minor divergence: NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY and AMZN (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +6.08%) CORRECTION show 1W/1M sign flip but insufficient majors for a Major Divergence signal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with dispersion: AAPL (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY, LRCX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -5.03%) RECOVERY; sector internals weak and breadth contributes to caution.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -4.34%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND — sector showing downside bias rather than leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with defensive elements but overall weak: UNH (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND while TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND — watch for stock-specific catalyst impact.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and selective Materials exposure given concentrated leadership; reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing below-trend behavior. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy dominance and weak Tech/Financial internals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +10.44%) — monitor earnings/capex headlines; BEARISH: Technology and Healthcare — internals remain weak and several large caps trading below trend.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY for failure of this 1W bounce as a trend-break trigger; monitor AAPL (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND for continued underperformance vs market; watch XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent highs as confirmation of Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
META (+85): Nebius deal; META (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -3.44%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price is falling (distribution). APD (+65): Wells Fargo upgrade; APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY — news aligns with 1W strength. NVDA (+55): new Groq 3 product; NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY — sentiment supportive but 1M still negative.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (-55): downgrade; QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming price weakness. ADBE (-50): CEO exit headlines; ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming sharp 1W sell-off. NEM (-45): gold weakness; NEM (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines aligned with price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given concentrated Energy leadership and weak overall breadth. XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (3/5 Energy) and headline-driven divergences such as META (+85) where bullish news contrasts with META (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -3.44%) BELOW TREND price action — monitor confirmation before broad exposure.
